comparison_policy.reason: The focused thprac trial starts with full Power and a clean phase history; the complete-route reference entered Final B with post-death resource and projectile history.
comparison_policy.architecture_metrics_are_comparable: Both traces report the same policy query, delay-support, and solver timing contracts.

conclusions.statement: Forecasted future epochs increased Final B policy queries from 80 to 8454 and constrained decisions from 32 to 3017.
The serial worker still left 8834 robust-mode decisions on expired policies because solve p95 was 175 frames against an 80-frame horizon.
The candidate retained 25 no-Bomb hit witnesses; 24 had a positive robust warning lead.
The raw 33-to-25 hit difference is not an acceptance claim because the phase-entry states differ.
